description: This file implements column display and formatting functions for a Git-related project, including layout calculations, display logic, and configuration handling for column options.

classes.name: column_data
classes.description: Structure holding data for column layout calculations, including list of strings, options, and layout metrics.

classes.name: colopt
classes.description: Structure representing a column option with name, value, and mask.

methods.name: item_length
methods.description: Calculates the display width of a string in characters, stripping ANSI escape sequences.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Calculates the number of rows and columns for displaying items in a table format based on available width.

methods.name: compute_column_width
methods.description: Determines the maximum width for each column based on item lengths.

methods.name: shrink_columns
methods.description: Reduces column sizes to fit within total width by decreasing rows and adjusting column count.

methods.name: display_plain
methods.description: Displays list items in plain format with indentation and newline.

methods.name: display_cell
methods.description: Prints a single cell in the table, handling spacing and line breaks.

methods.name: display_table
methods.description: Displays a list of strings as a formatted table with columns or rows.

methods.name: print_columns
methods.description: Main entry point to print a list of strings with column formatting based on options.

methods.name: finalize_colopts
methods.description: Adjusts column options based on whether output is a TTY or pager is in use.

methods.name: parse_option
methods.description: Parses individual column option strings into internal flags.

methods.name: parse_config
methods.description: Parses a comma- or space-separated string of options to configure column display.

methods.name: column_config
methods.description: Configures column options based on configuration variables.

methods.name: git_column_config
methods.description: Handles configuration for column options via environment variables or command-line.

methods.name: parseopt_column_callback
methods.description: Callback for parsing column options from command-line arguments.

methods.name: run_column_filter
methods.description: Starts a subprocess to filter output through the 'column' command with specified options.

methods.name: stop_column_filter
methods.description: Stops the column filter subprocess and restores output.
